name: Attachment List
tagline: The notes and attachments on a record, with download — and drag-and-drop upload.

limitations: Download reaches a Dataverse this page does not have. A file’s bytes are not on the view — they are fetched one row at a time with context.webAPI.retrieveRecord and handed to context.navigation.openFile, and the harness supplies neither. Pressing Download here does what the control does on any host that cannot deliver a file: it reports the press through its output property and says so in words. That is the real behaviour, and it is not a file.

Upload has nowhere to go. Attaching a file is a context.webAPI.createRecord on the Notes table, bound to the record the form is on through mode.contextInfo — and the harness has no Web API and no parent record, so there is no Add files button here and a dropped file is declined in words. That is what the control does on a main grid or in a canvas app; on an editable form it draws the button and writes the Note.
Text notes and files are both real. Everything else on the page — the glyphs, the sizes, the titles, the dates, hiding the text notes — is the control doing exactly what it does on a form.

Paging is inert. The harness seeds a single page and reports no next or previous page, so the pager renders disabled and the page-size property does nothing. On a form it is how many notes are fetched at a time.

presets.name: Notes and files
presets.description: What a Notes subgrid actually holds: four attachments and two text notes, with a glyph picked from each file's type.
